The completion of the order is projected by June 2027, reaffirming client confidence in the company's capabilities. Additionally, HFCL's consolidated profit has dramatically increased, driven by demand from AI data centres.

items.title: Adani eyes Chile's copper riches: Kutch Copper and Codelco sign MoU to explore Kaburkaala project
items.summary: Adani Group's Kutch Copper Ltd has signed an MoU with Chile's state-owned Codelco to explore the Kaburkaala copper project in northern Chile. The partnership aims to combine Adani's investment and technical capabilities with Codelco's geological expertise, potentially securing long-term copper supplies for the group's Mundra smelter as India seeks to strengthen its domestic copper supply chain.

items.title: Fraud through calls, messages a global threat: MoS Telecom
items.summary: Minister of State for Telecom Chandra Sekhar Pemmasani highlighted the threat of fraudulent activities at the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference. He emphasized the importance of trust in technology alongside expanding telecom network coverage. India's fraud alert system has successfully prevented significant monetary losses in recent years. The digital infrastructure in India has seen massive growth, with internet subscriptions reaching over 1.1 billion.

items.title: Two auto firms commit Rs 1,370 cr investment in Tamil Nadu, govt dismisses rumours of projects shifting to AP
items.summary: Two automotive manufacturers have committed to invest a total of Rs 1,370 crore in Tamil Nadu. Hwashin Automotive India will invest approximately Rs 850 crore over the next five years for various advancements. Seoyon E-Hwa Summit plans to invest around Rs 520 crore in technology upgrades and new business developments. The investments reflect the state's ongoing appeal to automotive investors.

items.title: India's net direct tax collections rise 11.8% to Rs 14.42 lakh crore from April 1 to Nov 10
items.summary: India's net direct tax collections recorded an increase of 11.76% to reach Rs 14.42 lakh crore. Gross direct tax collections rose by 14.02%, boosting receipts to Rs 17.50 lakh crore. Corporate tax collections grew by about 17.84%, amounting to Rs 6.32 lakh crore. Non-corporate tax collections saw a rise of 5.30%, increasing to Rs 7.56 lakh crore. Direct tax refunds increased significantly, reaching Rs 3.

items.title: Tea industry groups back panel's proposal for minimum sustainable price as costs outpace prices
items.summary: Five tea industry associations have welcomed the government committee's recommendation for a minimum sustainable price for tea. This recommendation aims to address rising production costs that are exceeding the prices received by producers. The proposed benchmark price is linked to wage movements and consumer price indices, which will be reviewed periodically. Producers believe this pricing mechanism will help absorb wage increases and support investment in tea production.
